## Audit Complete

I've found a task coverage gap in the calendar spec implementation:

**The Issue:**
The task required the meetings screen to show empty-state text `אין פגישות השבוע` when there are no meetings. While the spec was correctly updated with:
1. ✅ The `משתתפים` field added to the entity (properly wired in all UI surfaces)
2. ✅ A particle created with the empty-state text `[ריק] אין פגישות השבוע`

The **entity screen (ent1.dart) was not updated** to use the new empty state text. When users open the meetings screen with no meetings, it still shows the old placeholder `'אין פגישה עדיין — הרשומה הראשונה תופיע כאן'` instead of the required `'אין פגישות השבוע'`.

**Root cause:** The empty-state particle was created for the particles preview screen (px1), but the entity screen's empty state constant (`gen_app_calendar_ent1_c7`) was not updated when the particle was added to the spec.

**Severity:** P1 — Task requirement not met. The UI the user sees doesn't show the specified empty state text.

Details in `_audit-coverage.md`.
